Specification: This module is a very small wrapper around an instantiated module named FoldExcept. It declares a fixed set of seven processes, represented by the strings p1 through p7, and two state variables: clocks and drift. The comments indicate that clocks is intended to map process identifiers to integers and drift is intended to map process pairs to integers, but this file itself contains no initial-state predicate, next-state action, temporal specification, or properties to verify.
